title: Polytopes and $C^0$-Riemannian metrics with positive $h_{\rm top}$
summary: We study Reeb dynamics on starshaped hypersurfaces in $\mathbb{R}^4$ arising as smoothings of starshaped polytopes. Using the $C^0$--stability of positive topological entropy for Reeb flows in dimension three from our joint work with Dahinden and Pirnapasov, we show that there exist starshaped polytopes $P$ such that for any starshaped smoothing of $\partial P$ the associated Reeb flows have positive topological entropy.
